definitions.explanation: An activity done regularly for enjoyment during leisure time. Something one likes to do as a pastime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趣味|しゅみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{趣味|しゅみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}っています→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I take photos as a hobby.

notes:
{趣味|しゅみ} refers to hobbies or personal interests pursued for enjoyment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {趣味|しゅみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: What are your hobbies?
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趣味|しゅみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: My hobby is ~
- {趣味|しゅみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do ~ as a hobby
- {趣味|しゅみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to share the same hobbies

POPULAR HOBBIES:
- ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧: reading
- ⟦{映画鑑賞|えいがかんしょう}→映画鑑賞：noentry⟧: watching movies
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: travel
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: cooking
- ⟦{音楽鑑賞|おんがくかんしょう}→音楽鑑賞：noentry⟧: listening to music

USAGE NOTE:
{趣味|しゅみ} is a standard topic in Japanese self-introductions (⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧). When asked, it's common to answer with a noun: 「{趣味|しゅみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧」rather than using a verb.

SECOND MEANING:
{趣味|しゅみ} can also mean 'taste' as in aesthetic preference: {趣味|しゅみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (has good taste), {趣味|しゅみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (has bad taste).
